title: Anyone extensively journal their dreams?
content: I have recorded my dreaming every morning since 2004. Printed out, it’s a ream of paper front and back small font. My mall world has changed over time to incorporate new elements mostly related to my own travels. I find it’s often winter and snowy no matter the season in the waking world. There is an ocean with jagged rocks as coastline which is usually a dark place. A town like a ski resort that I work in. A place with yellow sky and hills. A multi storied building that defies physics. Family is sometimes there, but they take on different, exaggerated roles. Often, there are festivals or gatherings that I feel alone and isolated at. A restaurant where I’m new and just left to my own devices with no training. Running and hiding and staying one step ahead of someone or something. I’m become lucid about 2% of the time. I spend it looking at things intently, talking to dream characters about the nature of the dream, or conjuring someone to have sex with. The latter is my monkey mind and I’m working on not letting that take over. I had it under control for a while but in times of acute stress, it’s become a more common occurrence. Anyone else extensively journal? I’d love to hear about your recorded reoccurring themes.
